description: A drawing of the library gains a `<xhtml:text>` — built under `NO_ERRORS_SCHEMA` — and 1.4.5 keeps resting on the scan. Angular draws an HTML element of no kind inside the `<svg>`; its server renderer writes `<text>` into the page, which the browser's HTML parser keeps in SVG, a drawn text element after SSR (`DOMParser`, Chromium 153 and Firefox 155, 2026-10-19). Read with the `svg` prefix alone, the scan found none.
